title: Commute Route Variance by Weekday
dataSources: ADS-B aircraft snapshots (`adsb:aircraft`), personal flight logbook (`flight:log`), commute trips (`commute:trip`), transit arrivals (`transit:arrival`), geofence events (`geofence:event`), travel documents (`travel:document`), fare quotes (`airprice:quote`).
app: Home ADS-B receiver (dump1090 / readsb / tar1090 JSON feed), personal flight logbook exports, commute/transit APIs, and phone geofence webhooks via Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=commute:trip
| eval weekday=strftime(_time,"%A")
| stats avg(distance_km) as avg_km, stdev(distance_km) as sd_km, avg(duration_min) as avg_min by route weekday
| where sd_km>2 OR avg_min>45
| sort - avg_min
description: Compares distance and duration variance for each commute route by weekday so you can tell which route is robust and which one is chaos.
value: Routine travel becomes less stressful when you know which routes are merely longer and which are unpredictably worse.
implementation: Forward commute logs from a phone shortcut or travel app; review route statistics by weekday and choose default routes more deliberately.
visualization: Route table of average duration and distance variability by weekday.
grandmaExplanation: It warns which commute routes are the least predictable depending on the day of the week.
